description: Use this when a family asks what's in one NYC neighborhood, or where a kind of place is in it: a library, playgrounds, subway stations or bus stops, coffee, groceries, restaurants, things to do, family resources (rec centers, farmers markets), healthcare (pediatricians, urgent care, hospitals, dentists) or public, charter and private schools. Searches every place we map inside the neighborhood's boundary by name, street or kind (query), or lists every place of one kind (kind); with neither, returns what kinds of places are there, with counts. Results are grouped by category, with a link to each school's page and to the neighborhood's page, which lists every place. Use the nta_code from search-neighborhoods or find-neighborhood.

kind.description: List every place of one kind: a category (schools, parks, transit, restaurants, groceries, cafes, activities, resources = family resources, healthcare) or a specific kind (public-schools, charter-schools, private-schools, libraries, playgrounds, subway, bus, rec-centers, farmers-markets, pediatricians, urgent-care, hospitals, dentists). With a query, the query narrows within the kind.

nta_code.description: NTA code of the neighborhood (from search-neighborhoods or find-neighborhood)

query.description: What to look for: a place's name, a street, subway lines, or a kind of place in plain words ('library', 'coffee', 'subway', 'pediatrician'). Omit to list a whole kind, or to get the overview.

name: find-places
